name: opendart
description: Look up Korean company disclosures, profiles, and financials from the command line, powered by the opendart-client CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read Korean company disclosures and financials
interface.longDescription: Resolve a Korean company name/ticker/initials to a corp_code, list its disclosures, show its company profile, or summarize its key financial accounts -- from OpenDART (전자공시) via the opendart-client CLI.
